title: 〜ものか / 〜もんか
meaning: absolutely not, as if I would … (strong emotional denial)
simpleExplanation: 〜ものか is a rhetorical question that means an emphatic "no way": 二度と行くものか (as if I would ever go again). It expresses the speaker's determination or rejection with strong feeling. もんか is the casual spoken form; ものですか is the polite form used mostly by women in older-style speech.
whenUsed: Casual, emotional speech; also in dramatic writing. It sounds combative or defiant, so use it with care. In neutral speech use 絶対に〜ない.
formation: Verb (dictionary form) + ものか / もんか
い-adjective + ものか (悔しくなんかあるものか)
Noun + な + ものか (or である + ものか)
Polite: 〜ものですか / 〜もんですか

steps.ja: 絶対に二度と行かない
steps.en: I will absolutely never go again
as if I would ever go again! (defiant rhetorical denial)

examples.ja: あんな店、二度と行くものか。
examples.reading: あんなみせ、にどといくものか。
examples.en: As if I would ever go to that restaurant again!

examples.ja: 彼の言うことなんか信じるもんか。
examples.reading: かれのいうことなんかしんじるもんか。
examples.en: No way I would believe what he says.
examples.note: もんか: casual; rejecting what someone says.

examples.ja: こんなに難しい問題、解けるものですか。
examples.reading: こんなにむずかしいもんだい、とけるものですか。
examples.en: There is no way I can solve such a difficult problem.
examples.note: ものですか: polite form; strong denial of ability.

examples.ja: こんなチャンスを逃すものか。
examples.reading: こんなチャンスをのがすものか。
examples.en: There is no way I'll let this chance slip.
examples.note: Determination: as if I would miss it.

examples.ja: 彼が私の気持ちなど分かるものか。
examples.reading: かれがわたしのきもちなどわかるものか。
examples.en: As if he could understand my feelings.
examples.note: など strengthens the dismissive tone.

similarGrammar.difference: Strong logical denial ('there's no way that'); ものか is more emotional and often about the speaker's own will.
Quiet, literary 'will not'; ものか is loud and defiant.

commonMistakes.why: ものか already denies; attach it to the affirmative form.

commonMistakes.wrong: 報告書：この計画は成功するものか。
commonMistakes.right: 報告書：この計画が成功するとは考えにくい。

commonMistakes.wrong: あの人は親切なものか。(neutral tone intended)
commonMistakes.right: あの人は親切ではない。
commonMistakes.why: ものか always sounds defiant or scornful; do not use it for a plain negative.

usageNotes: Intensifiers: 絶対に, 二度と, 誰が, など / なんか.
誰が〜ものか = who would ever…? (nobody).
In fiction, もんか marks strong-willed or angry characters.
jlptTips: If the sentence expresses defiant refusal (二度と / 絶対に), ものか / もんか is the answer.
It attaches to the affirmative form; a negative before ものか is a common wrong option.
Distinguish from ものだ (norm) and ものの (although) by the final か.
